what: When feature sections chain: once a section’s top edge touches the top of the screen, the photo plate stays pinned until the section’s bottom edge rises one more screen (two screens). The dark veil over the plate deepens and a 6px blur turns on .2 later (scrub 1), while a text card rises from one screen below the photo and passes over the plate. The next section slides up over it.

duration.Scroll: Section top edge to bottom edge runs one extra screen above the viewport (two screens)

options.scrub: Trailing delay (sec), default 1 · if true, immediate
options.delay: How much later the blur arrives than the mask (timeline units), default .2
options.card-end: Position where the article card fully appears, default bottom 30%
options.phone-card-end: On phones (at or below the phone width), default bottom 10%
options.phone: Width treated as phone view (px), default 900

note: Give each section a larger z-index as you go down so the next section covers the photo stuck to the previous one. The original shows the dark overlay on phones only (display:none on PC)

from.where: index.html three features (.ku-feature__section — same timeline in index.js, photo at 104% size)
